Here's a description of the provided plot, following the guidelines:

The plot illustrates the relationship between epoch and Word Error Rate (WER) for different fine-tuning types. The x-axis is labeled “epoch” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 6, with tick labels at each integer value. The y-axis is labeled “WER” and has a linear scale ranging from 25 to 42.5, with tick labels at intervals of 2.5. A solid orange line, representing “small AdaLoRA_int4”, begins at approximately WER 36 at epoch 0, decreases to approximately WER 28 at epoch 3, and ends at approximately WER 26 at epoch 6. A dashed orange line, representing “small AdaLoRA_int8”, starts at approximately WER 30 at epoch 0, increases to approximately WER 38 at epoch 1, then decreases to approximately WER 25 at epoch 6. A dotted orange line, representing “small int8”, begins at approximately WER 33 at epoch 0, decreases to approximately WER 27 at epoch 3, and ends at approximately WER 26 at epoch 6.
